items.originalTitle: Red Bull reveals when its long-awaited new F1 wind tunnel will be operational
detailZh: 红牛公布其期待已久的新F1风洞将何时投入使用
Laurent Mekies表示，这支车队最先进的新设施可能只会帮助其2027赛季下半赛季的赛车开发
红牛期待已久的新风洞将在墨西哥大奖赛之前投入使用，但车队负责人Laurent Mekies确认，它将在2027赛季某个时期投入使用
位于米尔顿凯恩斯的新设施将取代位于贝德福德的现有风洞。它曾被称为前红牛车队负责人克里斯蒂安·霍纳的“冷战遗物”，车队非常期待它能带来的成果
它最初计划在2026赛季在线，因此车队粉丝会欣赏这次更新。
“在时间表方面，它还没有准备好，”他在Motorsport.com提问后对媒体说。“它将在下赛季的某个时候上线。是第一季度，还是第二季度，还是第三季度？我们将拭目以待。”
他还补充说，日期将取决于许多因素。
“它将基于我们上线所需的时间以及完成校准工作所需的时间。所以很可能是2027年车型的第二部分，希望是‘28车型的大部分。”
Mekies承认，尽管红牛车队在使用它的情况下取得了成功，但目前他们正在与可能是F1中最古老的气动力风洞合作。
马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队、劳伦特·梅基斯、红牛车队车队总监
“尽管我们使用的风洞在过去几年中最终产生了非凡的结果，但我认为你的评估是正确的，它很可能是赛道上最老的一个。”
红牛车队在2021年至2024年期间，使用贝德福德设施，与马克斯·维斯塔潘一起赢得了四个连续的车手冠军。事实上，红牛车队的2023赛季是锦标赛历史上最统治性的赛季——对于一个古董设备来说，这并不坏。
Mekies预计新的隧道会给车队带来提升，但这不会一蹴而就。
如果你跳到一个最先进的设施，并且车队真的尝试设计和现在生产出一些能让我们在那个领域回到最前面的东西，当然你期望从这里获得竞争优势。
所以，当我们开启一切时，它不会立即出现，但肯定能释放潜力，并为我们在空气动力学部门的才华横溢的人们提供另一种表达想法的方式。
detailEn: Red Bull reveals when its long-awaited new F1 wind tunnel will be operational
Laurent Mekies says the team’s state-of-the-art facility will most likely only help the second half of its 2027 car’s development

Red Bull has been waiting for its new wind tunnel for a long time now, but, ahead of the Mexican Grand Prix, team principal Laurent Mekies has confirmed that it will not come online until some point during the 2027 season.

This new facility in Milton Keynes will replace its current tunnel sat in Bedford. With it once being described by former Red Bull chief Christian Horner as a "Cold War relic", the squad is very much looking forward to enjoying the fruits it will surely bear.
It was originally meant to be online for the 2026 season, so fans of the team will appreciate the update.

“In terms of timeline, it is not ready yet," he told the media after a question from Motorsport.com. "It’s something that will come online sometime during next season. Is it first quarter, is it second quarter, is it third quarter? We’ll see.”
He added that the date will depend on a number of factors.

“It will be based on how much time we need to get it online first and then to complete the calibration work. So most likely for the second part of the 2027 car, and hopefully for most of the ‘28 car.”
Mekies admitted that Red Bull is currently working with what is likely to be the oldest wind tunnel in F1, despite the success the team has enjoyed with it.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Laurent Mekies, Red Bull Racing Team Principal

“As much as the wind tunnel we are using have been ultimately producing extraordinary results in the last few years, I think you are right in your assessment that it is most likely the oldest one on the grid.”

Red Bull won four consecutive drivers’ titles with Max Verstappen between 2021 and 2024 using the Bedford facility. In fact, Red Bull's 2023 campaign was the most dominant in the championship's history - not bad for an antique.
Mekies expects the new tunnel to give the team a boost, but it won't happen overnight.

“If you jump to a state-of-the-art facility, and the team have really tried to design and now produce something that will put us back at the very first place in that area, of course you expect a competitive advantage from there.

“So it’s not going to come up as soon as we switch on everything, but it’s certainly going to unlock potential, and to give the talented people we have in the aero departments another way to express their ideas.”
keyPointsZh: 新设施位于米尔顿凯恩斯，将取代贝德福德的现有风洞
前红牛车队负责人克里斯蒂安·霍纳曾将现有风洞描述为“冷战遗物”
keyPointsEn: The new facility is located in Milton Keynes and will replace the current tunnel in Bedford
The existing tunnel was once described by former Red Bull chief Christian Horner as a 'Cold War relic'

items.originalTitle: Guenther Steiner warns Mercedes will make "changes" if George Russell struggles in 2027
items.summaryEn: Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has warned that Mercedes could make changes to its driver line-up if George Russell is still struggling by the end of the 2027 season.
detailZh: 京特·施泰纳警告：若乔治·拉塞尔在2027年仍表现低迷，梅赛德斯将做出“改变”
前哈斯F1车队负责人京特·施泰纳警告称，如果乔治·拉塞尔的低迷状态持续到2027年底，梅赛德斯可能会替换他。
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
前哈斯一级方程式车队领队京特·施泰纳警告称，如果乔治·拉塞尔到下一个赛季结束时仍表现低迷，梅赛德斯可能会调整其车手阵容。
尽管拉塞尔以明显热门身份进入2026赛季，但他的队友基米·安东内利在中国大奖赛和日本大奖赛背靠背夺冠后，成为领跑积分榜的最年轻车手。此后他本赛季已总共赢下九场大奖赛，并即将夺得个人首个F1世界冠军。
进入本周末的墨西哥大奖赛前，拉塞尔在年度积分榜上排名第二，落后安东内利123分。这位英国车手还面临身后车手的压力。法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿仅落后一分排名第三，而积分榜第二到第五之间只相差九分。
施泰纳在《红旗播客》节目中表示，拉塞尔的问题更多在于信心而非赛车，并同意一种说法，即这位28岁车手的处境与丹尼尔·里卡多相似。
“我认为这更像是丹尼尔·里卡多式的情况，而不是刘易斯式的情况，”施泰纳说。里卡多在迈凯伦被兰多·诺里斯全面压制后，职业生涯再未恢复，并于2022年底被提前解除合同。
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
“我希望他能找回自己的路，因为丹尼尔（里卡多）不幸地没能真正找回状态，当时他被迈凯伦放弃后情况甚至变得更糟。那基本上毁了他，”施泰纳补充道。“但乔治身边有相信他的人，比如托托，这会有帮助。”
这位前车队负责人认为拉塞尔会受益于梅赛德斯老板托托·沃尔夫的支持，但他警告说，布拉克利车队不会永远等待。
“我认为到明年年底，如果他处于和现在相同的位置，梅赛德斯——而且这对托托来说不是个人问题——梅赛德斯会审视，‘我们这里需要做什么才能成为制造商世界冠军？’因为那是他们在这里要做的事，你不能因此责怪他们。
“如果乔治拿不出应有的表现，就会有所变动。我不是说他们正在积极推动变动，他们给了他时间，但如果情况没有起色，他们就会做出调整。”
detailEn: Guenther Steiner warns Mercedes will make "changes" if George Russell struggles in 2027
Former Haas F1 boss Guenther Steiner has warned that Mercedes could replace George Russell if his struggles continue to the end of 2027
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has warned that Mercedes could make changes to its driver line-up if George Russell is still struggling by the end of next season.

While Russell entered the 2026 season as a clear favourite, his team-mate Kimi Antonelli became the youngest driver to lead the standings after back-to-back wins at the Chinese and Japanese Grands Prix. He has since gone on to win nine grands prix in total this season and is on the verge of claiming his maiden F1 title.

Heading into this weekend's Mexican Grand Prix, Russell sits second in the championship, 123 points behind Antonelli. The Briton also faces pressure from those behind him in the standings. Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton is just one point behind in third, and only nine points separate P2 and P5 in the standings.
Speaking on The Red Flags Podcast, Steiner said Russell's problems were more about confidence than the car and agreed with a suggestion that the 28-year-old's situation resembled Daniel Ricciardo's.

"I think it is more a Daniel Ricciardo situation than Lewis," Steiner said. Ricciardo's career never recovered after he was outperformed by Lando Norris at McLaren and was released from his contract early at the end of 2022.
George Russell, Mercedes, Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren

"I hope he can find his way back, because Daniel unfortunately didn’t really find his way back, because it even got worse for him when he was let go by McLaren at the time. That basically destroyed him," Steiner added. "But George having people around him who believe in him, like Toto, that will help."
The former team chief believes Russell will benefit from having the backing of Mercedes boss Toto Wolff, but he warned that the Brackley outfit would not wait forever.

"End of next year, I think, if he’s in the same position as now, Mercedes, and it’s not a personal thing for Toto, Mercedes will be looking, ‘what do we need to do here to be manufacturer world champion?’ because that is what they are here to do, and you cannot hold that against them.
"If George doesn’t bring the performance, there will be changes. I’m not saying that they are actively working for changes, they give him time, but if it doesn’t happen, they will make changes."
keyPointsZh: 施泰纳曾担任哈斯F1车队领队。
keyPointsEn: Steiner is a former Haas Formula 1 team principal.
